keybinds.hidden: Original behavior: KeybindsManager is on inactive-by-default KEYBINDS GO498; its FixedUpdate is suppressed by GameObject activity. No OnDisable/reset method in dump.cs. Picking state persists on hiding until binding capture. Preserve this state when restoring source parity.
keybinds.restore_defaults: No reset/default Button among complete level0 52-Button inventory; no Reset method in KeybindsManager/Loader metadata; initial defaults only guarded InitializeKeybinds. Do not implement a new defaults control.

name.empty_or_whitespace: No explicit emptiness/trim/length check in TryChangeName/CheckProfanity/ChangeName; original value is saved, normalization only used for profanity test
name.invalid: Restore saved Name to input text; profanityAlert Animator trigger On; no write
name.valid: SetString(Name,inputName.text); update nameText; no PlayerPrefs.Save call in ChangeName itself
name.generated_name: PlayerManagerSingleplayer.Start checks GeneratedName and generates adjective+noun on first start; subsequently copies saved Name into HUD and input

menu.enter: TryToOpenMenu(0) rejects inFightMenu or menuOpen; activates pause menu then EnterMenu; disables movement, zeroes velocity, walking=false grounded=true, loads settings. TimeScale0 only when boxing flag true.
menu.exit: ExitMenu sets Animator Off for pause/trainer/daily; menuOpen false; movement true; boxing restores TimeScale1; commercial ad/audio callbacks follow. Native close animation0.166667s and open0.333333s.
menu.menu_key: PlayerManager.Update reads Keybind5; if not workout and AudioListener not paused, open/close menus. Input focus is not explicitly checked in recovered body.
